children: Dominach Oksana S., a Director, reported a sale of common stock at $85.5958 per share. The total sale amount reported was $625,876. The report shows 7,312 shares were disposed of in the transaction. Following the sale, Dominach directly owns 4,346 shares of common stock. These shares originated from restricted stock units that convert one-for-one into common stock and vest on September 10, 2026.
